content.title: Discover publishing and catalog options from the home page
content.description: A visitor lands on the home page to understand both halves of Fernwood Press at once, see the current catalog size, preview all four publishing packages with their commercial details, sample recently published books, and choose whether to enter the author publishing flow or the published-books showcase.
content.summary: Use the home page to discover both platform halves.
content.value: Turns the landing page into a discovery and routing hub for both publishing and catalog browsing.
criteria: The home page heading is `Publish your book with Fernwood Press`.
A `Start Publishing` call to action leads to the publishing packages page.
The page states the catalog size as `<count>+ books published through our platform`.
A `Choose a publishing package` section shows all four packages, each with its name, tagline, price, and a `View package` link.
A `Recently published` section shows four book tiles, and each tile's title links to that book's detail page.
`Compare all packages →` leads to `/publish`, and `Browse all published books →` leads to `/books`.
